method: Compare preserved source-clause adjudication and 0.8.0 class/Boundary arguments against applicable published 0.8.1 necessary conditions and all-role versus failure-only exclusions. Distinguish positive protected responses from original compromise; carry uncertainty through to the record.

cases.classification_reviewed: Unclassified; FC-055 and FC-067 assessed but unadmitted
cases.criterion_scope_reasoning: Earlier full v0.8.0 source-first review did not establish secondary-purpose use of private Codex material, material contribution-to-result lineage, or independent development. The v0.8.1 contribution-value exclusions cannot be deemed satisfied merely because the provider denies influence or because compute scale differs. Public chronology and mathematical-output provenance do not reconstruct transitive prompt/retrieval/tool access.
cases.remaining_work: Keep partial unclassified outcome without converting disputed appropriation to a finding. FC-067 current all-role exclusion matching and independent source-lineage assessment require targeted follow-up before an edition stamp.

cases.criterion_scope_reasoning: Malware-controlled CLI prompts entered lower-trust tool contexts; some AI tooling produced real inventories, while others refused or failed. The v0.8.1 FC-001 all-role exclusion for factual-content errors does not describe this operative instruction attempt. The FC-002 all-role exclusion for a mere vulnerability without any AI/governance permission conversion is not conclusively established for every AI invocation, but successful tool invocation is not proof of model-side reachability-as-authority. No unqualified failure or success is warranted.
cases.remaining_work: Retain distinct tool-specific boundaries; separate direct malware extraction and later stolen-token activity from AI-generated effects.

cases.criterion_scope_reasoning: The DJI service accepted the researcher's token and returned other owners' device data, establishing changed-target scope mismatch. FC-003 remains independently established. FC-002 availability/credential possession as a permission premise is not separately proven: the vulnerable backend's target-binding failure must not be double counted as a second authority inference without its distinct necessary condition. A technical service permission process was involved, so the mere-vulnerability-with-no-governance-process exclusion cannot be asserted without qualification.
cases.remaining_work: Reconcile the earlier current-v0.8.0 candidate packet with the exact FC-002 versus FC-003 difference and the remaining two unresolved clauses; leave FC-002 Boundary, not an admitted failure.

cases.criterion_scope_reasoning: Actual service restrictions and material reliance establish a governance-relevant act, rather than dependency alone. v0.8.1 FC-058 all-results scope exclusions for market dependency without exercised governance and for mere technical access-as-permission do not displace the bounded authority question. Ordinary operations/established legal, service or delegated authority remain possible exculpatory explanations; public material cannot settle them.
cases.remaining_work: Retain provisional/partial FC-058 Boundary and distinguish operational restrictions from unproven coercive political motive.

cases.classification_reviewed: Unclassified, with unresolved separate defensive-control activation candidate
cases.criterion_scope_reasoning: Reported provider key theft and unauthorised API usage are important service-governance effects but do not, without a specific authority conversion, show a VIGIL AI/control mechanism. Reported defensive refusals lack an established particular valid trigger and response trace; absence of disclosed private telemetry does not imply a refusal succeeded or a safeguard failed. A v0.8.1 candidate check is not proof of taxonomy-wide complete coverage.
cases.remaining_work: Preserve partial unclassified state and the unresolved defence-activation question; do not add a class or invent hidden mechanism.

validation_boundary: Canonical Incident files and generated indexes unchanged. Decisions do not count as canonically v0.8.1 until versioned record promotion, index regeneration, non-destructive rebuild checks and green CI.
human_assurance: No independent human assessment or fresh originating-source retrieval.
